Hello Shawn,

I've pulled up Shop···· on (email hidden) It shows the Canaan Avalon Q and the BrushO, both paid and delivered, the Avalon Q on September 11, 2025 on FedEx (number hidden). The order itself carries no separate coverage or service line, so the only entitlement attached is the warranty that came with the unit, and I'm not going to quote you a term I can't stand behind. The published warranty wording is being reconciled right now, so I'm having the exact terms for your serial confirmed rather than guessing at them.

Georges and Abel have both been pinged on this directly, with your serial, the Canaan ticket dates and the September 11 denial, and the specific ask: covered repair or replacement, or a seller RMA with an authorized ship-to in writing. One of them is picking it up today and you'll get their answer as a reply in this thread, so nothing more is needed from you to keep it moving.

Two things that will speed the decision along. Our RMA intake is this form, and it's the only route that produces a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform. And please confirm whether the unit was ever overclocked or had firmware changed, since modified units fall outside warranty and Georges will need that answered either way.

Sorry you've been chasing this since Sep 14 without a reply. That part is on us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
